description: Search and read Gmail, manage drafts and labels, send and reply to messages, and move messages to or from Trash. Powered by Composio.
example_prompts: Find unread messages from this week and summarize what needs my attention.
Draft a reply to the selected thread for my review.
anything_else: Built by Tendle with Composio. Provider permissions and quotas apply. Listing generation does not establish deployment or client verification.

authentication.credential: Connector-scoped bearer token issued after provider connection
authentication.configuration: Use native client OAuth; Composio holds the upstream service credentials.
authentication.note: Never distribute the operator Composio API key.
